rules.quote: In the unlikely event a product is not what you expected, you can return or exchange it with a receipt within 14 days of the date you receive the product from Apple.

uncovered.quote: The product must be in its original condition with all of its included parts, accessories, and packaging and we’ll exchange it or offer a refund based on the payment method.
uncovered.reason: No primitive can verify product condition or completeness, or enforce the payment-method-based refund method.

uncovered.quote: Apple products purchased through other retailers must be returned to those retailers in accordance with their returns and refunds policies.
uncovered.reason: No primitive records the retailer of purchase or enforces retailer-specific return routing.

uncovered.quote: Products can be returned only in the country where purchased.
uncovered.reason: No primitive or order field records the purchase or return country.

uncovered.quote: For returns for cash or cash equivalent over $750, Apple will mail a refund check to you within 10 business days.
uncovered.reason: No primitive enforces mailing a refund check based on payment type and amount or the associated deadline.

uncovered.quote: For returns with a gift receipt, Apple will offer you an Apple Gift Card.
uncovered.reason: No primitive records gift-receipt status or issues a gift card.

uncovered.quote: For returns paid with your Apple Account balance, Apple will refund the portion paid to your Apple Account or, if unable, an Apple Gift Card.
uncovered.reason: No primitive records the Apple Account payment portion or enforces that refund destination.
No primitive records or requires product inspection before a return.

uncovered.quote: If approved, a refund or exchange will be issued within 10 business days.
uncovered.reason: No primitive records an approval date or enforces a 10-business-day issuance deadline after approval.

uncovered.quote: If these features were activated and cannot be disabled by the person in possession, Apple may refuse the return or exchange.
uncovered.reason: No primitive records security-feature activation or whether it can be disabled.

uncovered.quote: To return ten or more of the same product, you must return to the Apple Store where purchased.
uncovered.reason: No primitive enforces a quantity-based requirement to use the purchasing store.

informational: We believe you will be thrilled with the products you purchase from the Apple Store.
Apple provides security features to protect your product in case of loss or theft.
For complete details on how to return a product purchased at the Apple Store please visit the Returns & Refunds page.
